locations.title: Raider Scav Mechanics
locations.description:
The Scav spawn mechanics on The Labs work differently to other maps.

Scav Raiders will begin spawning after 5 minutes.  Every couple of minutes there is a chance a Scav Raider will spawn. They can spawn anywhere and patrol anywhere.

Groups of 2-4 Scav Raiders will also spawn when any of the extraction buttons are pressed (you'll hear an announcement on the intercom).  When this happens, they spawn nearby the relevant extraction and patrol towards it.

locations.title: Residential Unit
locations.description:
**Key Required:** TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard (100% spawn in Labs Containment Block)  

**Behind the Lock:** 
- 8-10 valuable spawns
- Loose Loot (Bitcoins, GP, Statues, Roosters, lions) 
- Gun Spawn under Bed (RSASS, MK47, 300 Blackout Rifle, Velociraptor 300, TX-15) 
- Intelligence Folders and blue intelligence folders
- Up to 4 duffle bags

locations.title: Kruglov's Office
locations.description:

- Locked Safe (with valuables)

locations.title: Residential Key
locations.description:

This key on the map is incorrectly at the enterance to the whole area on the map, but only this room is behind the lock.
